options_blocking_help.message: Aturan khusus blokir during daftar hitam sesis. The daftar putih is what stays reachable during daftar putih sesis. Kategori bundel blokir common time sinks.

options_bundled_categories_help.message: Bundled lists of common time sinks. Beralih a whole kategori, then buka it to keep single situss tersedia.

options_schedule_help.message: Sesis start on their own inside these windows. Strictness set here applies for the whole window.

options_rules_help.message: facebook.com covers that domain and every subdomain. news.ycombinator.com covers that subdomain and anything under it. /youtube\.com\/pakhireks/ matches the full URL as a regular expression.

options_number_error_whole.message: $LABEL$ must be a whole number dari zero padaau grepadaer.

LABEL.example: Minutes of site access per 30 minutes of focus

options_number_error_minute_range.message: $LABEL$ must be within the supported menit range.

options_number_error_day_range.message: $LABEL$ must be within the supported hari range.

options_session_defaults_help.message: Mode and strictness are fixed ketika a sesi mulais. These are the values the mulai form bukas with.

options_mode_whitelist_label.message: Daftar putih: semuaow only listed situss

options_strictness_flexible_label.message: Fleksibel: akhir the sesi ketikaever you choose

options_strictness_friction_label.message: Gesekan: stopping early uses the configured deliberasi gerbang

options_strictness_hard_label.message: Keras: no early akhir, temporary situs akses only

options_cycle_help.message: Defaults: 25 menit focus, 5 menit break, 15 menit long break every 4th cycle. Breaks on a schedule beat break-when-you-feel-like-it for mood and focus in study samples. The exact menits are convention, not science.

options_cycle_default_label.message: Siklus fokus and istirahats by default

options_gate_help.message: A 10 detik wait with an explicit back-to-kerja tombol measurably reduces impulse visits (kolom study, PNAS 2023). The longer wait and the typed sentence roughly double the effect.

options_custom_delay_error.message: Custom delay must be a positive whole number of detiks.

options_gate_force_end_label.message: Aktifkan "Ignore timeout and end anyway" button

options_credit_help.message: Kredit akses laman accrues while you fokus. Both akses to semua situss and a single-situs unlock spakhir from the same balance. You can step away at any time without spakhiring credit.

options_earn_rate_label.message: Minutes of site access per 30 menits of focus

options_streak_help.message: The streak counts haris that reach the goal. One default session keeps the chain alive, and a freeze token repairs a missed hari.

options_category_uncheck_help.message: Uncheck a situs to keep it tersedia while the rest of the kategori is blokired.

options_session_complete_notification.message: Tampilkan a system notification when a session completes

options_badge_countdown.message: Tampilkan the remaining time on the toolbar icon

options_privacy_website_unregistered_tit.message: Situs web access is granted, but blocking is not active

options_privacy_website_unregistered_det.message: Chrome granted access, but Fokus Lock could not register its blocking script.

options_privacy_website_on_detail.message: Fokus Lock can apply your active blocking rules on regular website pages.

options_privacy_confirm_local_history_bo.message: This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from this device. It does not clear a running session, which keeps its intention and the address of each tab it is blocking. Akhiring the session clears the intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, and the cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.

This permanently deletes full URLs, focus intentions, and detailed session events from this device, plus local-only aggregate statistics. It does not clear a running session, which keeps its intention and the address of each tab it is blocking. Akhiring the session clears the intention and starts a cleanup that clears every open website tab, and the cleanup removes every stored address when it completes.

options_privacy_confirm_synced_policy_bo.message: This permanently hapuss remote pengaturan, blokir and semuaow lists, kredit akses laman, gariss, and domain-level blokired-attempt aggregerbangs from Chrome Sinkronisasi. Lokal pengaturan and statistics stay on this device.
